title: Facebook, troppa visibilità a estremisti e complottisti: ecco come impatta Meta sulle elezioni
snippet: A detailed media feature focusing on Professor Fabio Giglietto's analysis of over 2.5 million Facebook posts published between 2021 and 2025. It covers how Meta's political content filters backfired, leaving extremist and anti-EU pages as the top information ecosystem on Facebook while sidelining institutional democratic voices.
description: An article covering Professor Fabio Giglietto's research analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts, focusing on how political extremist pages bypassed Meta's filters to gain visibility during elections.
